metadata.title: The Vault — Curated Public Datasets for Accountability
metadata.description: A curated registry of open, mission-aligned datasets for exposing corruption, mapping conflict, and documenting human-rights abuse. Sourced from the Awesome Public Datasets catalog and vetted for global comparability and offline bundling potential.
metadata.license: CC0 1.0 (catalog metadata); each dataset retains its own license

datasets.name: ACLED — Armed Conflict Location & Event Data
datasets.description: Real-time, georeferenced data on political violence and protest events worldwide. Every recorded incident of armed conflict, battles, violence against civilians, riots, and protests with precise location, actor, and fatality data.

datasets.name: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP)
datasets.provider: Uppsala University, Dept. of Peace and Conflict Research
datasets.description: The gold-standard academic dataset on armed conflict since 1946. State-based, non-state, and one-sided violence, with battle-related deaths, dyadic records, and peace agreements. Underpins most quantitative conflict research.

datasets.name: Correlates of War Project
datasets.description: Quantitative data on wars, militarized interstate disputes, alliances, national material capabilities (CINC scores), and interstate trade. The foundational dataset for international-relations statistical analysis.

datasets.name: Center for Systemic Peace — Polity & State Fragility
datasets.description: Polity IV governance scores (autocracy–democracy spectrum), state fragility index, conflict trends, and societal-systems analysis. Widely cited for regime-type and instability modeling.

datasets.name: GDELT — Global Events Database
datasets.description: Real-time monitoring of news media across every country in over 100 languages, coded into a massive event database (CAMEO). Tracks protests, conflict, diplomacy, and social signals as they unfold globally.

datasets.name: OONI — Open Observatory of Network Interference
datasets.provider: Open Observatory of Network Interference / Tor Project
datasets.description: The largest open dataset on internet censorship. Measurements of blocked websites, apps, and manipulation of networks worldwide. Names the ISPs and middleboxes performing censorship and the domains being blocked per country.

datasets.name: OpenSanctions
datasets.description: Aggregated, deduplicated database of sanctioned persons and companies and politically-exposed persons (PEPs). Merges OFAC, EU, UN, UK HM Treasury and 30+ other lists into one searchable, cross-referenced registry of accountability targets.
datasets.license: CC BY 4.0 (data varies by source list)

datasets.name: EveryPolitician
datasets.description: Data on every politician in every country's legislature — names, parties, terms, gender, identifiers. Enables accountability research by linking public officials to their records across time and borders.

datasets.name: Fragile States Index
datasets.description: Annual country-level assessment of state fragility across 12 indicators (demographic pressures, refugees, group grievance, human flight, uneven development, poverty, legitimacy, public services, human rights, security apparatus, factionalized elites, external intervention).

datasets.name: WHO Global Health Observatory
datasets.description: WHO's gateway to health statistics for 194 countries — mortality, morbidity, life expectancy, maternal/child health, non-communicable diseases, mental health, health systems, and risk factors. The authoritative source for public-health indicators.

datasets.name: Gapminder World — Demographic Databases
datasets.description: Curated time-series of global demographic, health, and economic indicators spanning 200+ years. Income, life expectancy, child mortality, fertility, education — harmonized for cross-country comparison and trend analysis.

datasets.name: World Inequality Database (WID.world)
datasets.provider: World Inequality Lab (Paris School of Economics)
datasets.description: The most extensive open database on historical income and wealth inequality. Top-decile and top-percentile income shares, wealth concentration, and distributional national accounts for nearly every country.

datasets.name: Our World in Data
datasets.description: A research portal with 6,000+ charts across 300 topics — poverty, health, climate, energy, war, democracy, education. Every dataset is downloadable, sourced, and harmonized for long-run comparison. A one-stop reference for global development.

datasets.name: ND-GAIN — Notre Dame Global Adaptation Index
datasets.description: Country-level index of vulnerability to climate change and readiness to adapt. 45 vulnerability indicators (exposure, sensitivity, adaptive capacity) plus economic, governance, and social readiness scores. Identifies where climate crisis hits hardest.

datasets.name: World Bank Climate Change Data
datasets.description: Climate-specific country data via the World Bank Climate API — historical temperature and precipitation projections, disaster risk, and climate-smart agriculture indicators. Country-level downscaled climate scenarios.

datasets.name: NOAA Climate Datasets
datasets.provider: U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration
datasets.description: Authoritative archive of global climate observations — land and ocean temperature records, paleoclimate, atmospheric CO2, extreme-event data, and reanalysis products from the leading U.S. climate agency.

datasets.name: USGS Earthquake Archives
datasets.description: Searchable archive of global earthquake events with magnitude, depth, location, and impact. Real-time feeds and historical catalogs (1900–present). Critical for disaster-risk and humanitarian-impact mapping.

datasets.name: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX)
datasets.description: The UN's shared platform for humanitarian data — displacement, refugee populations, crisis indicators, humanitarian access, and needs assessments. Thousands of datasets from 1,000+ organizations, all crisis-relevant and frequently updated.

datasets.name: INFORM Index for Risk Management
datasets.description: Global, open index of humanitarian risk. Combines hazard exposure, vulnerability, and lack of coping capacity into a composite risk score per country. Sub-national versions available for the most fragile states.

datasets.name: WorldPop — High-Resolution Population Maps
datasets.description: Open, high-resolution (100m) gridded population datasets for every country — total counts, demographics, births, pregnancies, and population movements. Essential denominator data for per-capita crisis metrics and displacement estimation.

datasets.name: AQUASTAT — Global Water Resources
datasets.description: FAO's global information system on water and agriculture. Country-level data on freshwater resources, withdrawal, access, irrigation, dams, and transboundary basins. The primary reference for water-scarcity and WASH analysis.

datasets.name: UN Human Development Reports
datasets.description: The Human Development Index (HDI) and its variants — inequality-adjusted HDI, gender development index, multidimensional poverty index. The UN's composite measure of well-being spanning health, education, and income.

datasets.name: World Bank Open Data
datasets.description: Thousands of development indicators — GDP, health, education, environment, poverty, private-sector — for 200+ countries over 50+ years. The single most comprehensive free source of macro-social data, accessible via a clean API.

datasets.name: UN Data — United Nations Statistics
datasets.description: A single entry point to 60+ million records across 35+ UN statistical databases — population, trade, energy, environment, crime, health, refugees. Cross-searchable, country-keyed, and authoritative.

datasets.name: OECD Data
datasets.provider: OECD (Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development)
datasets.description: Internationally comparable data on economics, society, and governance — inequality, health spending, education, environment, tax, trust. Covers OECD members and key partner countries with rigorous methodology.

datasets.name: Maddison Project Database — Historical GDP
datasets.description: Comparative historical GDP, population, and per-capita income data from year 1 CE to the present. The standard source for long-run economic growth comparisons across countries and centuries.

datasets.name: Atlas of Economic Complexity
datasets.description: Database of global trade flows and economic complexity — what every country exports, to whom, and how diversified its productive capability is. Reveals structural economic dependencies and industrial capacity.

datasets.name: UN Comtrade — Commodity Trade Statistics
datasets.description: Detailed international merchandise trade statistics — billions of trade flows by product (HS code), partner, and year. Track arms transfers, food exports, resource extraction, and supply chains between any two economies.

datasets.name: Global Power Plant Database
datasets.description: Comprehensive, open database of every power plant worldwide — capacity, generation, fuel type, owner, location, and commissioning year. Pinpoints fossil-fuel dependence and renewable potential for every grid.

datasets.name: SIPRI Military Expenditure
datasets.description: The definitive dataset on military spending — country-level expenditure in USD, local currency, and as % of GDP, plus arms transfers and arms industry. The benchmark behind every 'spending vs need' comparison.

datasets.name: Natural Earth — Vector & Raster Maps
datasets.description: Public-domain map dataset at 1:10m, 1:50m, and 1:110m scales — country boundaries, coastlines, rivers, roads, populated places, and physical features. The standard free basemap already powering this platform's choropleth.

datasets.name: GeoNames Worldwide
datasets.description: Geographical database of 11+ million place names with coordinates, alternate names, population, and administrative hierarchy. The reference for geocoding, place search, and reverse-lookups across all countries.

datasets.name: World Countries in Multiple Formats
datasets.description: Comprehensive country data in 26+ formats — ISO codes, currencies, languages, calling codes, capital cities, top-level domains, translations, and flags. The canonical reference for country-key joins and i18n.

datasets.name: EM-DAT — International Disaster Database
datasets.description: The global reference for disaster data — over 26,000 mass-disasters (natural and technological) since 1900 with deaths, injuries, homelessness, and economic damage by country. Underpins disaster-risk and climate-impact research.

datasets.name: World Populations at Risk (Minority & Indigenous)
datasets.description: Country-level indicators on persecution risk for minority and indigenous communities — discrimination, displacement, cultural suppression, and atrocity-warning signals. Supports early-warning and accountability documentation.

datasets.name: Penn World Table
datasets.provider: University of Groningen (GGDC) / University of California Davis
datasets.description: Comparative national accounts — real GDP, productivity, capital stock, labor input, and total-factor-productivity for 182 countries. Purchasing-power-parity-adjusted and the workhorse dataset for cross-country growth accounting.

datasets.name: World Development Indicators (WDI)
datasets.description: The World Bank's flagship collection of cross-country development indicators — GDP, GNI, balance of payments, debt, trade, inflation, employment, and 1,400+ macro series for 217 economies since 1960. The canonical free source for standardized national accounts and cross-country comparison, served through a documented API.

datasets.name: Global Financial Development Database (GFDD)
datasets.description: Financial-sector indicators for 214 economies — depth, access, efficiency and stability of banks, bond, equity and insurance markets, plus systemic-banking-crisis flags. Exposes where capital is concentrated, who is credit-constrained, and where financial fragility is building.

datasets.name: GovData360
datasets.description: Composite governance, business-regulation and public-sector indicators for 210+ economies drawn from over 30 sources — tax burden, ease of paying taxes, regulatory quality, government effectiveness, and procurement transparency. The Atlas view lets you compare how each country's business climate and state capacity stack up against peers.

datasets.name: Business Ready (B-READY)
datasets.description: Successor to the Doing Business index — annual, methodology-revised benchmark of the business environment in 50+ economies covering regulatory framework, public services, and efficiency of firm entry, operation and exit. Useful for spotting over-regulation, crony carve-outs and barriers to competition.

datasets.name: IMF Data Portal
datasets.description: Unified entry point to the IMF's macroeconomic and financial databases — national accounts, monetary aggregates, exchange rates, external sector, debt, and balance of payments for 190+ member countries. The institutional reference standard for comparable cross-country macro statistics.

datasets.name: IMF World Economic Outlook (WEO)
datasets.description: Twice-yearly IMF forecasts of GDP growth, inflation, unemployment, trade balances, current-account and debt for every country through the medium term, plus scenario assumptions. The most widely cited set of forward-looking macro projections and the baseline for sovereign-risk modelling.

datasets.name: IMF International Financial Statistics (IFS)
datasets.description: High-frequency financial and macroeconomic series — exchange rates, interest rates, monetary aggregates, prices, production and international liquidity — for IMF members. The granular time series behind most central-bank and FX analysis, updated monthly.

datasets.name: IMF Direction of Trade Statistics (DOTS)
datasets.description: Bilateral trade in goods between every pair of IMF member countries — exports, imports and balances by partner, monthly and quarterly. Reveals dependency networks, sanctions exposure and shifts in trade alliances that single-country aggregates hide.

datasets.name: IMF Global Debt Database
datasets.description: Total debt stocks by sector — government, household, non-financial corporate and financial — for 190 countries since 1950, the most comprehensive long-run debt series available. Essential for spotting leverage build-ups, sovereign-distress risk and austerity pressure.

datasets.name: Trading Economics
datasets.description: Near-real-time macroeconomic and market indicators for 196 countries — GDP, inflation, unemployment, interest and policy rates, currency, equity and commodity prices, plus economic calendars and forecasts. A convenient single pane for tracking fast-moving market signals and central-bank decisions across jurisdictions.

datasets.name: BIS Statistics
datasets.description: Global financial data from the central banks' bank — cross-border bank claims, international debt securities, foreign-exchange turnover, credit-to-private-sector, property prices and the BIS early-warning indicators. The definitive source for systemic-financial-risk monitoring and shadow-banking exposure.

datasets.name: UNCTADstat
datasets.provider: UN Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD)
datasets.description: Trade, investment, commodities and development statistics — FDI flows and stocks, trade in goods and services, merchant fleet, commodity prices, and structural indicators for developing economies. Strong on commodity dependence, extractive-industry revenue and South–South flows.

datasets.name: WTO Statistics & Trade Profiles
datasets.description: Multilateral trade statistics — merchandise and commercial-services trade, tariff profiles, trade in value-added (TiVA), and annual country trade profiles. Tracks trade openness, tariff barriers and the reshaping of global value chains.

datasets.name: FRED — Federal Reserve Economic Data
datasets.provider: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis
datasets.description: Over 800,000 US and international economic time series — output, employment, prices, money, rates, plus a deep catalogue of other countries' national accounts and OECD/IMF imports. Free, well-documented API and the de facto tool for reproducible macro charting.

datasets.name: ECB Statistical Data Warehouse
datasets.description: Euro-area monetary, financial and balance-of-payments statistics — money supply M1–M3, bank lending rates, sovereign yields, TARGET balances and the SDW's bond and equity series. Crucial for tracking eurozone stress, sovereign spreads and ECB policy transmission.

datasets.name: ILOSTAT — Labour Statistics
datasets.description: Official labour-market statistics — employment, unemployment, wages, hours, informal economy, child labour and working poverty — for 190+ countries with modelled estimates filling gaps. Reveals where economic growth is (and is not) translating into livelihoods, and tracks inequality of opportunity.

datasets.name: FAOSTAT — Food & Agriculture Statistics
datasets.description: Production, trade, prices, land use, emissions, and food-balance sheets for food and agriculture across 245 countries and territories. The backbone of food-security and commodity-revenue analysis — from grain export bans to fertilizer prices and land grabs.

datasets.name: JODI — Joint Organisations Data Initiative (Oil & Gas)
datasets.description: Monthly oil and natural-gas production, demand, imports, exports, stocks and refining data for over 100 participating countries. The transparent, multi-agency benchmark for tracking energy revenue, supply shocks and the fossil-fuel dependencies that fund and constrain regimes.

datasets.name: Our World in Data — Economic Growth & Living Conditions
datasets.provider: Our World in Data (Global Change Data Lab)
datasets.description: Long-run, well-documented series on GDP, incomes, poverty, inequality, consumption and the structural transformation of economies — harmonized from Maddison, WDI, WID and others into clean, citable datasets. Ideal for visual storytelling and cross-century comparison.
